filo_ambulance.description:
- Add `esx_addonaccount` as a society provider, so fees and shop purchases go into `society_<job>` on ESX. `provider = 'auto'` picks it when no other banking resource runs
- Fix wheelchairs not working on QBCore and ESX: picking one up checks for room in the inventory and pushing checks job and duty through the framework bridge

filo_appearance.description:
- Add client exports `getWornClothing` and `takeOffClothing(group)` so radial menus and other scripts can take clothing pieces off, with the same animation and inventory handling as `/takeoff`
- Add `setr filo_appearance:textui` and `setr filo_appearance:textui_position` convars to pick the text UI from `server.cfg` without editing `config.lua`
- Move the variant arrows onto the selected style tile; they only show when that style has more than one variant

filo_bolt.description:
- Fix `canCancel = false` being ignored, so the minigame could always be cancelled
- Fix bolts spawning on the inner side of right-hand wheels
- Fix the player staying frozen and invisible if the resource stops mid-minigame
- Fix the minigame not ending when the vehicle is deleted or moves away, or the player dies
- Fix the `Start` export returning `nil` instead of `false` when it can't start
- Fix the ratchet sound cutting off and reloading on every bolt

filo_chat.description:
- Rework the UI in the Filo liquid chrome look: graphite surfaces, silver chrome buttons and highlights, upright sentence-case text, no glows, gradients or scanlines
- Change the default `accent` and `background` to the liquid chrome colours (`#D9DBE0` / `#141415`). Set your own colours in the branding config to keep your look

filo_consumables.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_discordgate.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_drugscreator.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_fastfood.description:
- Add **Move with gizmo** to every spawn, path, counter and line point
- Change **Record points** to **Place points**: move a see-through copy of yourself with a mouse gizmo and press E to drop each point, Enter when done
- Change seat placement to the mouse gizmo while you sit in the seat: drag the arrows to move, the ring to turn, click to drop it, hold right mouse to look around

filo_firefighter.description:
- Add random flame sizes and types, so no two flames look the same
- Add smaller tongues of fire and a smoke column around every flame
- Add a map blip for every active fire for all on-duty firefighters (also ones who clock in after it started), a small blip on each burning flame nearby and an arrow over each flame (`Config.fire.blip`, `Config.fire.markers`)
- Add an aiming pose for the hose nozzle (`Config.hose.aimAnim`)
- Change the hose line to look much thicker (`Config.hose.ropeStrands`, `Config.hose.ropeWidth`)
- Change fires to start with twice as many flames (`Config.fire.startFlamesPerIntensity`) and grow to more (`Config.fire.maxFlamesPerIntensity` is now 5)
- Change flame size and variety to be set in `Config.particles` (`size`, `cluster`, `always`, `flameSmoke`)
- Fix flames placed around a location's centre floating or sitting underground on uneven ground
- Fix new flames stacking on top of each other
- Fix the truck cannon still spraying with an empty tank, or for players who aren't on-duty firefighters
- Fix fire trucks that didn't come from a garage having no water

filo_jack.description: - Remove the `community_bridge` dependency: a built-in bridge now detects Qbox, QBCore or ESX. You can remove `community_bridge` from your server if nothing else uses it

filo_joblib.description:
- Add QBCore and ESX support next to Qbox. The framework is picked automatically, and the framework code is in the editable `bridge/` folder
- Fix carries and escorts staying attached when either player logs out to the character menu or the other player disappears

filo_muffler.description: - Refactor vehicle state management and update version checker

filo_police.description:
- Add QBCore and ESX support next to Qbox. The framework is picked automatically, and the framework code is in the editable `bridge/` folder
- Change the unpaid clamp list to read `owned_vehicles` on ESX
- Change the bundled filo_joblib to 1.1.0

filo_radio.description:
- Add a `Handheld at mouth` talk animation
- Add per-animation prop placement: `prop` in `Config.Animations` can be a table with `offset`, `rotation` and `bone`
- Rework the radio look into a realistic duty handheld with an amber backlit screen, speaker grille and rubber keys
- Change the radio's top plate to show `Config.Branding.name`
- Change the transmit-off sound to a cleaner double beep
- Remove the `Handheld (VS Radio)` animation

filo_rewards.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_slashtire.description:
- Add qb-target support
- Add translatable labels under `locales/`
- Change slashing to be checked by the server (distance and held weapon)
- Fix only the last slashed tire syncing to players who join later or drive up to the vehicle
- Fix players getting stuck in place while turning towards the tire
- Fix players staying marked as busy if the slash was interrupted

filo_stealwheels.description: - Remove the `community_bridge` dependency: a built-in bridge now detects Qbox, QBCore or ESX, `ox_inventory` and `ox_target` or `qb-target`. You can remove `community_bridge` from your server if nothing else uses it

filo_ui.description:
- Rework the quick menu into a pause menu layout: player and server header, a player card, large Map and Resume tiles, Settings and Keybinds tiles, and key hints with Tebex and Disconnect at the bottom
- Change quick menu arrow keys to move to the nearest tile in that direction
- Change the default HUD editor command to `/hud` (`Config.HudEditor.command`)
- Fix status icons sitting off-centre in the `arc`, `slant` and other non-classic HUD styles
- Fix the food and health icons being drawn slightly off-centre

filo_vehiclekeys.description:
- Fix animated engine parts moving while the engine is off
- Fix the engine shutting off when the driver leaves a running vehicle
